lines.1: In the end, we headed home without accomplishing anything that day.
lines.2: 「There are all sorts of juices in the refrigerator. What are those for?」
lines.3: Otome asked while biting straight into an apple.
lines.4: 「Oh, don't worry about them. Drink whatever you want.」
lines.5: 「Very well. I shall have one if I grow thirsty.」
lines.7: Biting right into it, huh? Pretty wild.
lines.8: Just what I'd expect from an athlete.
lines.11: Otome watched me as she ate her apple.
lines.13: 「I was wondering what you were doing.」
lines.14: 「As you can see, I'm reading manga and relaxing.」
lines.15: 「You're not going to scold me, are you?」
lines.16: 「...No. Rest is necessary too. I shall say nothing.」
lines.19: 「Exercise, soothe your tired body in the bath, and sleep soundly. That is the secret to good health.」
lines.21: 「There is no disadvantage to strengthening the body.」
lines.22: 「It'll pay off in our old age too.」
lines.23: 「Indeed. And it is vital to have muscle when the need arises.」
lines.24: 「I get the logic. It's just a pain.」
lines.25: 「Heh heh heh... Such a weak will. You will be most rewarding to train.」
lines.26: This was what I got for being honest, but lying would only make her angry.
lines.27: Was there no way to win?
